newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bond yields seen up 5-7 bps on French vote.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bond yields seen up 5-7 bps on French vote.

text.p: 0935/0635 GMT - Finnish bond yields were expected to start five to seven basis points higher after the French left-wing parties outpolled the ruling centre-right coalition in the first round of voting in the French election on Sunday.
* Before the opening, the 2006 bond yield was quoted at 6.24 percent, up six basis points from Friday's 6.18 percent close.
* London and U.S. closed for holiday on Monday which was seen dampening volumes and reaction to French election.
* Dealers said the surprising turn in France would increase doubts about a smooth passage towards European economic and monetary union.
* Early markka shade softer versus mark, in line with other crosses as German mark supported by French election. Dealers expect DEM/FIM to trade in 3.01-3.03 range.
